settings_desc.default_price_mode: Whether quoted prices include tax by default. A tax that states its own mode overrides this.
settings_desc.default_rounding_policy_co: The rounding policy applied when a calculation request does not name one. Leave empty to require every request to state one.
settings_desc.org_default_currency: The currency this organization keeps its books in. Every stored amount that names no currency of its own — a product's base sales price or cost, for instance — is denominated in it. Leave empty only if no such amount is used.
settings_desc.require_override_reason: Refuse a manual tax override that carries no written reason.
tax.array_operator_requires_list: This operator compares against a list of values.
tax.component_cycle: This component already contains the tax being composed, so the composition would form a cycle.
tax.component_parent_not_draft: The tax version this component belongs to is no longer a draft. Create a new version to change what the tax is composed of.
tax.component_self_reference: A tax cannot be a component of itself.
tax.fixed_amount_requires_currency: A fixed tax amount must state the currency it is denominated in.
tax.fixed_amount_requires_uom: A fixed tax amount must state the unit it is charged per.
tax.invalid_lifecycle_transition: A tax configuration cannot move to that status from its current one.
tax.jurisdiction_cycle: The parent chain of this jurisdiction contains a cycle.
tax.jurisdiction_self_parent: A tax jurisdiction cannot be its own parent.
tax.jurisdiction_too_deep: The jurisdiction hierarchy is nested more deeply than is supported.
tax.mapping_line_maps_to_itself: A mapping line must substitute one tax for a different one.
tax.mapping_line_parent_not_draft: The mapping this line belongs to is no longer a draft. Create a new mapping version to change what it substitutes.
tax.noComponents: No tax components were applied to this line.
tax.none_calculation_requires_no_charge_: A calculation type of 'no calculation' is only valid with exempt, non-taxable or out of scope.
tax.nullary_operator_takes_no_value: This operator tests presence and takes no comparison value.
tax.operator_requires_value: This operator needs a comparison value.
tax.period_ends_before_it_starts: The effective end date must be on or after the effective start date.
tax.published_field_immutable: This configuration is published. Create a new version instead of changing a field that decides how tax is calculated.
tax.published_not_deletable: A configuration that has been published cannot be deleted. Withdraw or archive it instead.
tax.published_rate_overlap: Another published rate of this tax already covers part of this period. A tax date must resolve to exactly one rate.
tax.published_version_overlap: Another published version of this tax already covers part of this period. A tax date must resolve to exactly one definition.
tax.rate_and_fixed_amount_both_set: A tax rate carries either a percentage or a fixed amount, never both.
tax.rate_or_fixed_amount_required: A tax rate must carry either a percentage or a fixed amount.
tax.rounding_increment_not_positive: The rounding increment must be greater than zero.
tax.rule_result_requires_mapping: The action 'apply mapping' must name the mapping to apply.
tax.rule_result_requires_tax: This action must name the tax it applies to.
tax.rule_result_requires_treatment: The action 'no tax applicable' must state whether the supply is non-taxable or out of scope.
tax.unknown_condition_field: That is not a field of the tax context that a rule can test.
tax.zero_rated_requires_percentage: A zero-rated tax is charged at 0% and must use calculation type 'percentage', not 'no calculation'.
tax_error.fixed_tax_currency_conversion_: This fixed tax is quoted in a different currency and no exchange rate contract exists.
tax_error.multiple_tax_mappings: More than one tax mapping applies, so the outcome is ambiguous.
tax_error.no_applicable_tax_determined: No tax could be determined for this line. This is not the same as no tax being due.
tax_error.rounding_policy_missing: No rounding policy is in effect for this currency and jurisdiction.
tax_error.tax_classification_missing: This line has no tax classification, so no rule can decide what applies.
tax_error.tax_rate_ambiguous: More than one published rate of this tax covers the tax date.
tax_error.tax_rate_missing: This tax has no published rate covering the tax date.
tax_error.tax_uom_conversion_unavailable: The quantity cannot be converted into the unit this fixed tax is charged per.
